subject: Vendor registration, escrow account & PO matching for Stratus Health
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratushealth.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, ap@stratushealth.com
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor registration & invoice handling requirements for Redwood

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — Stratus is ready to move forward with formal vendor setup so our AP team can route purchase orders and start billing. To get the vendor token activated in our portal we need the following from Redwood:

- Completed vendor registration form (attached)
- W-9 or tax certificate (for US vendors)
- Bank confirmation letter for EFT (account holder name, routing, account number, bank letterhead)
- Copy of a sample invoice matching our PO requirements (see PO matching rules below)

A few notes on our invoice/PO policy:
- PO number is required on every invoice and must be in the "PO#" invoice field (we can't accept it only in the description)
- Invoice line-level GL mapping is not required initially, but please include a single line-item description and total; we will perform PO-to-invoice match on amount and PO#
- We support split invoices for multi-deliverable engagements but each invoice must reference the originating PO
- Remit/pay cycles: standard NET60; early-pay programs available if you enroll in our EarlyPay portal (we can send an invite)

One additional ask from Procurement: for any prepayment or retention >USD 25,000 we require funds to be held in the Stratus escrow account until milestone acceptance. Is that acceptable? If so, please confirm the bank details you want used for settlement and whether Redwood can sign the Stratus escrow addendum (we can send via DocuSign).

Please return the completed vendor form and W-9. We can provision the vendor token within 24–48 hours once we have the bank letter.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Lead, Supplier Onboarding — Stratus Health
AP & Procurement
[Attachment: vendor_registration_form.pdf (pdf)]

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratushealth.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & invoice handling requirements for Redwood

Elena — thanks, and great to hear.

We'll get the vendor form and W-9 to you today. A couple quick clarifications so the provisioning and PO routing are smooth on our side: 

1) PO format — do all Stratus POs use the ST- prefix? Example we saw in the portal was ST-2026-4581. We want to ensure our invoice generator writes the exact PO# into the "PO#" field you require.

2) Escrow — Redwood generally prefers direct EFT settlement. We can sign an escrow addendum for the instances you outlined (prepayment > $25k). Will Stratus own the escrow account or is it a neutral third-party trustee? Also please confirm whether Stratus expects Redwood to invoice the full amount and have AP move funds to escrow, or if Stratus will issue an escrowed PO.

Naomi — can you attach the signed bank letter and the W-9 we can return? Also adding Laura for account coordinator visibility on invoice formatting.

I will prepare a sample invoice that puts the PO number in the dedicated PO# field and includes the invoice header you requested.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: price_schedule-stratus.xlsx (workbook) — will send sample invoice in follow-up]

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & invoice handling requirements for Redwood

Jordan / team — attaching the W-9 and bank confirmation draft. See details below (I'll attach a signed bank letter PDF once legal signs off):

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
- Tax docs: W-9 attached (W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf)
- Preferred settlement: ACH / FedWire (we accept either; ACH preferred for recurring payments)
- Bank: First Federal Bank
- Account holder: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- We will provide an official bank letter on bank letterhead—target to send by EOD 2026-06-07 PST (attached as draft bank_letter_signed.pdf)

On VAT/tax: Redwood is a US-headquartered entity; for Stratus accounts outside the US we will provide appropriate VAT self-certificates or local tax forms as needed, but for this engagement (U.S. entity) the W-9 and EIN should be sufficient.

Invoice cadence: Redwood typically issues monthly invoices tied to delivered usage and committed seats. We can make invoices NET60 as requested; we can also enroll in your EarlyPay program if you share the merchant invite link.

Attachments: W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf; bank_letter_signed.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratushealth.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T21:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & invoice handling requirements for Redwood

Elena — looping in Finance and Account Ops. A suggested mutual action plan so we can go live quickly: 

- 2026-06-07: Redwood returns vendor form, W-9, draft bank letter (in process) — DONE
- 2026-06-09: Stratus provisions vendor token in portal & shares sample PO — Stratus action
- 2026-06-10: Redwood sends signed escrow addendum (only if Stratus will escrow >$25k) and uploads bank letter — Redwood action
- 2026-06-11: First test invoice submitted (sample PO) — Redwood action
- 2026-06-14: AP test payment (small value) to verify EFT routing — Stratus action

Two practical questions: 
1) DocuSign — please route the Stratus supplier agreement & escrow addendum (if used) to marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com and naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com. We will have legal/finance sign within 48 hours when received.

2) Partial invoices & split deliverables — we can support split invoices as you requested. We recommend including a short line item referencing the PO and the milestone ID to help your match rules. If you need a specific invoice reference ID field, let us know the field name and we'll map our generator to write it.

Attaching a short price schedule so you can verify the line items and totals we will include on the sample invoice.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success (Finance Ops Liaison) — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: price_schedule-stratus.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratushealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ap@stratushealth.com, tom.hsu@stratushealth.com
Date: 2026-06-09T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & invoice handling requirements for Redwood

Thanks — quick update from AP: we've provisioned Redwood in the vendor portal and sent a sample PO (ST-2026-4581) to your account email. Please use that PO when creating your test invoice.

On escrow: Stratus will use a neutral third-party trustee. We will route the DocuSign for the escrow addendum and supplier agreement by EOD today to marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com.

I'll also send an invite to the EarlyPay pilot; if Redwood signs up you can get paid as soon as net-30 in exchange for a 1% fee.

Please confirm when you upload the bank letter and sample invoice so we can run the test payment on 2026-06-14.

Best,
Elena Morales
Lead, Supplier Onboarding — Stratus Health
